svg.text: S0 level: clocked inverters; S1 level: transmission gates
F10 selector mux4_1: passes one of the four flip-flop outputs q[0..3] to selected_q
ui_in[3] (S0) picks one input of each pair with clocked inverters; uio_in[6] (S1) picks the pair with two transmission gates
(the floating transistors in the middle); the output inverter drives selected_q.
Rails: VDD at the top, VSS at the bottom; every PMOS body is on VDD and every NMOS body on VSS (drawn inside the symbol). A dot marks a connection; wires that cross without a dot are not connected.
